method_card.title: Speed, Density & Pressure
steps: Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Rearrange: D = S × T, T = D ÷ S.
Density = Mass ÷ Volume. Pressure = Force ÷ Area. Same triangle pattern.
Match units first: minutes to hours, and length units before a volume.
To find the top of a triangle, multiply; to find a bottom, divide.
method_card.content:
Three compound measures share one pattern: a top quantity equals the two below it, combined.

Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Density = Mass ÷ Volume. Pressure = Force ÷ Area.

Use a formula triangle: cover the quantity you want and what is left is the calculation. Covering a bottom corner leaves a division; covering the top leaves a multiplication.

Always make units agree first: change minutes to hours for km/h, and match length units before finding a volume.
method_card.example:
A block has mass 450 g and volume 50 cm³. Find its density.

Density = Mass ÷ Volume = 450 ÷ 50 = 9 g/cm³.

bronze.display: A car travels 240 km in 4 hours. What is the speed?
bronze.hint: Speed is distance divided by time: 240 ÷ 4.

misconceptions.message: Speed is Distance ÷ Time, not Distance × Time. 240 ÷ 4 = 60 km/h.

guided_steps.say: Speed = Distance ÷ Time. The distance is 240 km, the time is 4 hours.

guided_steps.hint: Speed × time should give the distance back.

guided_steps.done: 60 km/h works forwards and backwards, so the speed is right.

bronze.display: A train travels at 80 km/h for 3 hours. How far does it go?

guided_steps.say: Distance = Speed × Time. Speed 80 km/h, time 3 hours.

guided_steps.hint: Multiply the speed by the time.

guided_steps.done: Divides back to 80 km/h, so 240 km is right.

bronze.display: A cyclist covers 30 km at 15 km/h. How long does it take?
bronze.hint: Time is distance divided by speed: 30 ÷ 15.

misconceptions.message: Time is Distance ÷ Speed: 30 ÷ 15 = 2 hours, not 15 ÷ 30.

guided_steps.say: Time = Distance ÷ Speed. Distance 30 km, speed 15 km/h.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 30 km, so 2 hours is right.

bronze.display: A block has mass 200 g and volume 25 cm³. Find the density.
bronze.hint: Density is mass divided by volume: 200 ÷ 25.

misconceptions.message: Density is Mass ÷ Volume: 200 ÷ 25 = 8 g/cm³, not Volume ÷ Mass.

guided_steps.say: Density = Mass ÷ Volume. Mass 200 g, volume 25 cm³.

guided_steps.pre: A 50 cm³ piece of the same metal has mass 8 × 50 =
guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 200 g, so 8 g/cm³ is right.

bronze.display: A liquid has density 1.4 g/cm³ and volume 50 cm³. Find the mass.

guided_steps.say: Mass = Density × Volume. Density 1.4 g/cm³, volume 50 cm³.

guided_steps.pre: A 100 cm³ amount would have mass 1.4 × 100 =
guided_steps.done: Divides back to 1.4 g/cm³, so 70 g is right.

bronze.display: A force of 120 N acts on an area of 4 m². Find the pressure.
bronze.hint: Pressure is force divided by area: 120 ÷ 4.

misconceptions.message: Pressure is Force ÷ Area, not Force × Area. 120 ÷ 4 = 30 N/m².

guided_steps.say: Pressure = Force ÷ Area. Force 120 N, area 4 m².

guided_steps.pre: The same force on 6 m² gives 120 ÷ 6 =
guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 120 N, so 30 N/m² is right.

bronze.display: An object has mass 600 g and density 3 g/cm³. Find the volume.
bronze.hint: Volume is mass divided by density: 600 ÷ 3.

misconceptions.message: Volume is Mass ÷ Density: 600 ÷ 3 = 200 cm³, not Mass × Density.

guided_steps.say: Volume = Mass ÷ Density. Mass 600 g, density 3 g/cm³.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 600 g, so 200 cm³ is right.

bronze.display: A pressure of 50 N/m² acts on an area of 6 m². Find the force.

guided_steps.say: Force = Pressure × Area. Pressure 50 N/m², area 6 m².

guided_steps.pre: The same pressure on 10 m² gives 50 × 10 =
guided_steps.done: Divides back to 50 N/m², so 300 N is right.

silver.display: A car travels 90 km in 1 hour 30 minutes. Find the speed in km/h.
silver.hint: Change 1 hour 30 minutes to 1.5 hours, then divide 90 by it.

misconceptions.message: 1 hour 30 minutes is 1.5 hours, not 1 hour. 90 ÷ 1.5 = 60 km/h.

guided_steps.say: Speed = Distance ÷ Time, but the time must be in hours first.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 90 km, so 60 km/h is right.

silver.display: A runner covers 400 m in 50 seconds. Find the speed in m/s.
silver.hint: Speed is distance divided by time: 400 ÷ 50.

misconceptions.message: Speed is Distance ÷ Time: 400 ÷ 50 = 8 m/s, not Time ÷ Distance.

guided_steps.say: Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Metres and seconds give m/s directly.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 400 m, so 8 m/s is right.

silver.display:
Not drawn accurately
A metal cube has sides 5 cm and mass 750 g. Find the density.
silver.hint: Cube the side for the volume, then divide the mass by it.

misconceptions.message: The volume is 5³ = 125 cm³, not 5. Density = 750 ÷ 125 = 6 g/cm³.
5² = 25 is an area, not a volume. The cube's volume is 5³ = 125, so 750 ÷ 125 = 6 g/cm³.

guided_steps.say: Density = Mass ÷ Volume. First find the cube's volume.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 750 g, so 6 g/cm³ is right.

silver.hint: To go from km/h to m/s, divide by 3.6.

misconceptions.message: To change km/h to m/s, divide by 3.6, not multiply. 72 ÷ 3.6 = 20 m/s.

guided_steps.say: To change km/h to m/s, divide by 3.6 (that is 1000 m ÷ 3600 s).

guided_steps.done: Returns to 72 km/h, so 20 m/s is right.

silver.display: A woman weighing 600 N stands on one foot with area 0.02 m². Find the pressure.
silver.hint: Pressure is force divided by area: 600 ÷ 0.02.

misconceptions.message: Pressure is Force ÷ Area: 600 ÷ 0.02 = 30000 Pa, not Force × Area.

guided_steps.say: Pressure = Force ÷ Area. Force 600 N, area 0.02 m².

guided_steps.hint: Dividing by 0.02 is the same as × 50.

guided_steps.pre: On double the area, 0.04 m², the pressure is 600 ÷ 0.04 =
guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 600 N, so 30000 Pa is right.

silver.display: A car travels at 50 mph for 2 hours 24 minutes. How far does it go?
silver.hint: Change 2 hours 24 minutes to 2.4 hours, then multiply by 50.

misconceptions.message: 2 hours 24 minutes is 2.4 hours (24 ÷ 60 = 0.4), not 2.24. 50 × 2.4 = 120 miles.
Do not drop the 24 minutes: 2 h 24 min = 2.4 h, so 50 × 2.4 = 120 miles.

guided_steps.say: Distance = Speed × Time. Put the time into hours first.

guided_steps.done: Divides back to 50 mph, so 120 miles is right.

silver.display: An alloy is made by mixing 300 g of metal A (density 10 g/cm³) with 400 g of metal B (density 8 g/cm³). Find the total volume.
silver.hint: Find each metal's volume with mass ÷ density, then add them.

misconceptions.message: Find each volume separately (Mass ÷ Density), then add: 30 + 50 = 80 cm³. You cannot add the densities.

guided_steps.say: Find each metal's volume with Volume = Mass ÷ Density, then add.

guided_steps.hint: Mass of A ÷ density of A.
Mass of B ÷ density of B.
Volume × density gives the mass back.
guided_steps.done: A gives 300 g, B gives 400 g, back to the start. 80 cm³ is right.

gold.display: A train travels 180 km at 90 km/h, then 120 km at 40 km/h. Find the average speed for the whole journey.
gold.hint: Find the time for each leg, add the distances and times, then divide.

misconceptions.message: Do not average the two speeds. Each leg takes a different time. Total distance ÷ total time = 300 ÷ 5 = 60 km/h.

guided_steps.say: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. Find each leg's time.

guided_steps.hint: Add the distances (300 km) and times (5 h), then divide.
Average speed × total time rebuilds the distance.
guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 300 km over 5 h. Averaging 90 and 40 would wrongly give 65.

gold.display:
Not drawn accurately
A cylinder has radius 3 cm, height 7 cm, and mass 594 g. Find the density to 1 d.p.
gold.hint: Volume of a cylinder is πr²h; square the radius first.

misconceptions.message: Volume of a cylinder is πr²h, so square the radius: π × 3² × 7 ≈ 197.9. Density = 594 ÷ 197.9 ≈ 3.0 g/cm³.

guided_steps.say: Density = Mass ÷ Volume. Volume of a cylinder is πr²h.

guided_steps.hint: Mass ÷ volume, then round to 1 d.p.
Density × volume gives back roughly the mass.
guided_steps.done: ≈ 594 g, so 3.0 g/cm³ is right.

gold.display: A car passes point A at 12:15 and point B (60 km away) at 13:00. Find the average speed.
gold.hint: The time is 45 minutes, which is 0.75 hours.

misconceptions.message: The time is 45 minutes = 0.75 hours (45 ÷ 60). Speed = 60 ÷ 0.75 = 80 km/h.

guided_steps.say: Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Work out the time as a fraction of an hour.

guided_steps.pre: From 12:15 to 13:00 is 45 minutes. In hours: 45 ÷ 60 =
guided_steps.hint: 45 minutes is three quarters of an hour.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 60 km, so 80 km/h is right.

gold.display: An object exerts 500 N on the ground. Doubling the contact area would change the pressure by what factor?
gold.hint: Pressure and area are inversely linked: double one, halve the other.

misconceptions.message: Pressure is inversely proportional to area: if the area doubles, the pressure halves. Factor = ½.

guided_steps.say: Pressure = Force ÷ Area. The force 500 N stays the same; only the area changes.

guided_steps.pre: Double the area, so the bottom of Force ÷ Area is multiplied by
guided_steps.hint: The area is doubled, so the denominator × 2.

guided_steps.pre: Dividing by twice as much halves the result. New pressure = old pressure ×
Check with numbers: area 1 m² gives 500 ÷ 1 = 500; area 2 m² gives 500 ÷ 2 =
guided_steps.done: 250 is half of 500, so the factor is ½.

gold.display:
Not drawn accurately
A 200 g block of metal measures 5 cm × 4 cm × 2 cm. What is its density?
gold.hint: Multiply all three sides for the volume, then divide the mass.

misconceptions.message: Volume is length × width × height = 5 × 4 × 2 = 40 cm³, not one face. Density = 200 ÷ 40 = 5 g/cm³.

guided_steps.say: Density = Mass ÷ Volume. First multiply the three sides for the volume.

guided_steps.done: Rebuilds 200 g, so 5 g/cm³ is right.

problem_bank.bronze_description: Use one formula (speed, density or pressure) when the units already match.
problem_bank.silver_description: Convert units first (minutes to hours, km/h to m/s) or find a volume before dividing.
problem_bank.gold_description: Multi-step problems: average speed, cylinder volumes, and reasoning about the formula.

worked_examples.question: A car travels 180 km in 2.5 hours. Find the average speed.

bronze.title: Bronze: one formula, matching units
steps: Speed = Distance ÷ Time. Density = Mass ÷ Volume. Pressure = Force ÷ Area.
All three share one shape: a top quantity divided by a bottom one. To find a top quantity instead, multiply the other two.
Write the formula, put the numbers in, divide (or multiply), then add the units.

example.question: A car travels 150 km in 3 hours. Find the speed.

silver.title: Silver: convert units, then use the formula
steps: Time: change minutes to hours by dividing by 60. So 1 h 30 min = 1.5 h and 2 h 24 min = 2.4 h.
Speed units: km/h to m/s divide by 3.6; m/s to km/h multiply by 3.6.
Solids: find the volume first (cube = side³), then Density = Mass ÷ Volume.

gold.title: Gold: multi-step compound measures
steps: Average speed = total distance ÷ total time. Never just average the speeds unless each leg takes equal time.
Cylinder volume = πr²h: square the radius, not the diameter.
Work in stages: find each part (time, volume), keep them, then combine at the very end.

steps.content: Averaging 12 and 6 gives 9, which is wrong ✓
